item.title: [CRITICAL] CVE-2026-18401: The non-blocking (asynchronous) JSON parser in jackson-core does not enforce the...
item.description: The non-blocking (asynchronous) JSON parser in jackson-core does not enforce the maxNumberLength constraint defined in StreamReadConstraints (default: 1000 characters). An attacker able to submit JSON to an application that uses the async parser API can supply a number token of arbitrary length, leading to excessive memory allocation and potential CPU exhaustion, resulting in a denial of service.
